question: How much did Sapiom raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: Sapiom's $35M says the 'demo-to-production' gap is now a fundable category - and Anthropic bought in.
hits.snippet: Short version: On August 5, 2026, a San Francisco startup called Sapiom - barely 11 months old - raised a $35M Series A led by Dragonfly, with Anthropic, Coinbase Ventures, Accel and VanEck Ventures on the cap table.
